observations.content: On branch fix/agnt-0032-frontier-spend, git diff reports 77 insertions and 28 deletions across tools/skill-eval/src/model.rs, src/service.rs, and five frontier tests; .memory/ is untracked.

The frontier infrastructure event model includes serde-defaulted charged_millionths_of_dollar: u64 in tools/skill-eval/src/model.rs:612, service records reservation charges, and lifecycle aggregation uses checked_add with an overflow error.

Frontier tests were updated to cover charged_millionths_of_dollar, including lifecycle value 10, zero-valued scheduler/report/store fixtures, and backward-compatible store deserialization when the field is absent (loads as 0).
Validation did not complete: cargo clippy --bin skill-eval -- -D warnings and RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo build --bin skill-eval both exited with code 101.

The strict Rust checks produced thousands of dead-code errors across source.rs, statistics.rs, store.rs, t1_screen_campaign_store.rs, t1_screen_store.rs, tier_writer.rs, and verifier.rs, ending with 1390 and 1385 previous errors respectively.

Clippy additionally reported suspicious_open_options at src/frontier_store.rs:111 because create(true) lacks explicit truncate behavior, and large_enum_variant for FrontierInspection in src/model.rs:751 because Trial contains a 528-byte TrialRecord versus a 192-byte infrastructure event; it suggested boxing TrialRecord.
